sources.title: GitHub - llm-guy/jarvis: Jarvis is a voice-activated, conversational AI ...
sources.snippet: Jarvis is a voice-activated, conversational AI assistant powered by a local LLM (Qwen via Ollama). It listens for a wake word, processes spoken commands using a local language model with LangChain, and responds out loud via TTS. It supports tool-calling for dynamic functions like checking the current time.

sources.title: OpenJarvis — Personal AI, On Personal Devices
sources.snippet: Browse and pull local models any time with jarvis model. Read the full docs → Pick a model, or let OpenJarvis pick one for your hardware. Manages the full catalog of local models across providers. The inference runtime — Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and cloud APIs. Auto-detects your hardware and recommends the best fit.
